clues.text: After Adam was driven from Eden, cherubim and a whirling flaming one guarded the way to the tree of life.
When Jesus was arrested, Simon Peter drew one and cut off the right ear of Malchus.
After felling Goliath with a stone, David pulled the giant's own from its sheath and cut off his head.
Balaam's donkey turned off the road into a field after seeing the angel of the LORD holding a drawn one.
Paul tells believers to take up the helmet of salvation and this one, which belongs to the Spirit.
Ehud made a double-edged one a cubit long and strapped it to his right thigh under his cloak.
When two women each claimed the same baby, King Solomon told his servants to bring him one.
